rv.q: The play's true battle is not between two different types of humanity, but rather between its highbrow ambitions and tawdry story.
The multiple twists and turns in the plot will keep the audience engaged.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this audience-jury murder mystery reimagining, with some finding it a chaotic spectacle that loses focus, while others praise its provocative and entertaining approach to Ayn Rand's interactive courtroom drama.
